lines.text: The men of Jabesh rejoiced at the promise of deliverance, and Saul divided the troops into two divisions.

problems.problem: Its true detail "camp of the Ammonites" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
"Philistine camp" and "camp of the Ammonites" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
